evidence_type: Offline device bytes plus retained Ghidra exports

dependencies.videoanal_flag_set_after: queue, mutex and frame task creation succeed
dependencies.ambalink_pool_same_as_application_pool: Yes on the two recovered stock paths: application setup publishes 0xa0fd7114 through 0xa01e66f4 to 0xa13a23e4; both NetBase callers load it.
dependencies.pool_identity_caveat: Static value flow; no current live pool state was read and unindexed indirect writers are not excluded.

allocation.wait_limit_caveat: Finite allocation wait is not a whole-command deadline or a fault watchdog.
allocation.rpc_allocations_error_handling: Multiple callers use returned pointers without checking NULL; task-create/register return values are ignored.

lifecycle_findings.disable: Unregisters the VideoAnal frame callback and sets state 1; does not release frame/reader buffers, RPC stack, or RPC service.
lifecycle_findings.repeat_init_nonzero_state: Resets active and reader indices and flushes headers; not a deinit/reinit path.
lifecycle_findings.init_registration_error: Init sets state 1 after sharepreview_register; inner register return value is discarded.
lifecycle_findings.frame_gate: Counter increments before geometry check; equality to period is required; reset happens only in the copy wrapper.
lifecycle_findings.copy_capacity: Copy uses input pitch*height; no explicit destination-capacity check found in the inspected copy function.

limitations: Saved pseudocode has inferred types; assembly is authoritative for the checked sites.
No new REA session was used; this report has filesystem evidence, not REA Evidence IDs.
Static failure paths are possible mechanisms, not demonstrated causes of the earlier incident.
No current RTOS pool capacity, fragmentation, live task state or input image geometry was read.
Finite allocator waits do not prove absence of other blocking or faults in transitive callees.
Stock RTMP caller excerpt is not a complete recovery of that callback or its mode-switch preconditions.
